# AethexCloud

> Reliable cloud infrastructure for websites, VPS, Minecraft servers, Discord bots, and Lavalink nodes.

AethexCloud provides hosting infrastructure for creators, developers, and growing communities. Services run on AMD EPYC processors and NVMe SSD storage in Mumbai, India.

## Key facts

- AethexCloud is a cloud hosting provider serving creators, developers, and online communities.
- Infrastructure is located in Mumbai, India.
- Plans use AMD EPYC processors, NVMe SSD storage, KVM virtualisation, and a 1 Gbps network uplink.
- Services are designed for websites, VPS workloads, Minecraft servers, Discord bots, and Lavalink audio nodes.
- Pricing is listed in Indian rupees and plans start from ₹10/month for selected services.

## Services

- [Website Hosting](https://aethexcloud.com/services): Hosting for portfolios, blogs, static sites, and full-stack web applications.
- [Virtual Private Servers](https://aethexcloud.com/services): KVM virtualised VPS plans with full root access, NVMe storage, and a 1 Gbps network uplink.
- [Minecraft Server Hosting](https://aethexcloud.com/services): Minecraft hosting for private worlds and public servers, with support for Vanilla, Paper, Spigot, and Forge.
- [Discord Bot Hosting](https://aethexcloud.com/services): Always-on hosting for Node.js, Python, and other Discord bot runtimes.
- [Lavalink Hosting](https://aethexcloud.com/services): Low-latency Lavalink nodes for Discord music bots.

## Infrastructure

- Location: Mumbai, India
- Processor: AMD EPYC
- Storage: NVMe SSD
- Network: 1 Gbps
- Virtualisation: KVM
- Uptime target: 99.9%
